reported_success.quote: These results replicate and extend the Boyle, Kennedy, and Shea (2012) and Boyle, Panzer, Wang, Kennedy, and Shea (2013) ﬁndings.

notes: Original analytic n left null: printed Methods N=27 conflicts with ANOVA denominator df=30; no n inferred from df. Replication uses four groups (sine/Fitts × amplitude), with no Impulse group. Authors’ success statement is a paper-level verdict, not a separate verdict for each ANOVA. No printed numerical statistic or numerical p for the requested Test 2 simple comparison; omnibus interaction not substituted. Replication values, where supplied, describe the located sine-versus-Fitts condition test and are a known mismatch to the requested three named groups including Impulse; do not combine them with the original group definition.
